Name: Garden Pot Tweaks
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod adds the following functionality for garden pots:

[list]
[*][b]Moving pots with crops, bushes, and / or fertilizer[/b]
[*][b]Triggering flower-based honey for pots[/b]
[*][b]Watering crops in pots with sprinklers[/b]
[*][b]Planting ancient seeds in pots[/b]
[/list]
To pick up a pot without destroying its contents, use a Pickaxe. If the crop is ready to harvest but you just want to pick it up, you can use the pickaxe in front of the pot rather than on it (which would harvest it).

To destroy the crop in a pot, use an Axe.

By default this mod also changes the vanilla flower finding logic to calculate actual distance between pots and bee houses.

Planting ancient seeds is disabled by default, since there's an actual in-game reason given for why it is disabled.

You can toggle any of the above settings in the config.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
